title: AI Automation Engineer (0–3 Years Experience)
description:
🚀
**We're Hiring: AI Automation Engineer (0–3 Years Experience)**

📍
**Company:**
TOPGRILLS

🏢
**Industry:**
Home Improvement | Invisible Balcony Grills

💼
**Role:**
AI Automation Engineer / Workflow Automation Specialist

🎯
**Experience:**
Freshers to 3 Years

**We don't care about your degree as much as what you can BUILD! 🔥**

At
**TOPGRILLS**
, we specialize in Invisible Balcony Grill installations, and we're looking for a smart, creative, and execution-focused
**AI Automation Engineer**
to automate our entire business workflow.

**🎯 Your Mission:**

Build an end-to-end automated system that manages our customer journey from
**New Lead → Final Payment Received.**

**⚙️ What You'll Build:**

✅
**Lead Automation**
– Capture leads from Facebook, Instagram, Website, WhatsApp & other sources into one CRM.

✅
**AI-Powered Follow-ups**
– Automate WhatsApp messages, lead nurturing, reminders & customer communication.

✅
**Sales Pipeline Automation**
– Track leads, customer interactions, site visits, quotations & conversions.

✅
**Installation Workflow**
– Automate scheduling, team assignments, installation status & customer updates.

✅
**Payment Tracking**
– Automate payment reminders, balance tracking, payment confirmations & status updates.

✅
**Business Dashboard**
– Build real-time dashboards for sales, pending installations, collections & business performance.

**🛠️ Skills We're Looking For:**

* n8n / Make / Zapier / Pabbly Connect
* AI tools, LLMs & API integrations
* WhatsApp Business API & CRM automation
* Google Sheets / Airtable / Database integrations
* Webhooks, basic coding & problem-solving

**🌟 Who Should Apply?**

✅ Freshers with impressive automation projects

✅ Professionals with 0–3 years of experience

✅ Self-learners who love building AI-powered systems

✅ Problem-solvers who can take ownership from idea to execution

**💡 What We Offer:**

🚀 Opportunity to build a real-world AI automation ecosystem from scratch.

🧠 Freedom to experiment, innovate & implement your ideas.

📈 Direct business impact, practical experience & growth opportunities.

💰 Compensation based on skills, project experience & capabilities.

**📩 Interested?**

DM me with:

1. Your CV / LinkedIn profile
2. Automation projects you've built (videos or demos preferred)
3. Tools you're comfortable with
4. Expected compensation

**No fancy degree required. Show us what you can build!**

Know someone who loves AI automation? Tag them below! 👇
